comments.author: daveplx
comments.body_html:
Thank you for the mod, I just noticed two things that I thought I’d propose:

- Maybe use Github or Codeberg or something to host your mod and link the download to that one’s. Fewer clicks and code can be forked / picked up by someone else if that’s alright with you (license is your decision)

- it’s best practice for the zip to contain a structure that users can drop right into their base SPT folder.

So it should contain “user/mods/EpaKim1” and “user/mods/Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader” like so

<zip base> └ user └ mods ├ EpaKim1 └ Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader Apart from that your zip is properly structured to also work on Linux, so thank you for that
